content.text:
I submitted **index 22** (Cu 0.17 / Sb 0.83), the best of the three compositions I measured, but every signal was tiny. None of these films performed well as a photoanode.

| Index | Cu / Sb | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 22 | 0.17 / 0.83 | **0.00456** (best) |
| 16 | 0.31 / 0.69 (close to CuSb₂O₆) | 0.00385 |
| 5 | 0.66 / 0.34 | −0.0145 |

- **Index 16:** I measured this first because the MACE model puts CuSb₂O₆ on the stability hull, meaning it should form at that ratio. I ignored MEGNet's 0.02 eV band-gap prediction for it, which isn't believable for a copper(II) oxide. The response was weak anyway.
- **Index 5:** MACE puts Cu₂SbO₅ far off the hull (1.16 eV/atom), so this film is probably mostly CuO, and it gave no anodic photoresponse.
- **Index 22:** MEGNet gives Sb₂O₄ a 1.67 eV gap, below the 2.1 eV light, and the Gaussian-process model also pointed to the unexplored Sb-rich end. It came out slightly ahead of index 16.

Index 22 beat index 16 by only about 0.0007 percentage points; I have no repeat measurements, so I can't tell whether that gap is real or noise. With only three merit measurements, 26 of the 29 compositions went unmeasured, including the whole range between indices 5 and 16. I didn't use any of the five XRD measurements, so the phases I name for each film are inferred from composition, not confirmed.
